## Style preference context

What design decision or appearance is preferred, and why?

What is the original design's shortcoming?

Is this a generally reusable architectural pattern, or a preference specific to your project?

## Maintainer classification (not contributor verification)

This is a **subjective** contribution, never evidence of correct redstone behavior.
Submission status is **quarantined** regardless of contributor rating.
Only a maintainer may approve an example after rights, privacy, technical-format
and relevance review. Approval only makes it an optional style example;
it does not become a global default preference or functional circuit rule.

Never attach private chats, authentication credentials or unreviewed world files.
